meta.name: security-scan
meta.description: 对进入系统的文件或 URL 执行安全与合规扫描，输出 pass/reject 判定与扫描报告，作为所有文档处理的强制前置关卡。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描文件与链接，输出安全放行或拒绝的判定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要先审文件或链接是否安全再决定放行
copy.tagline_en: Scan files and links, return pass or reject verdicts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to vet files or links for safety before approving access

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会作为文档入口的守门人：收到文件或 URL 时先做安全合规扫描，检查域名黑名单、许可状态和可疑来源，输出 pass/reject 判定与扫描报告，并留下追踪 ID。
howto.when: 当文件或 URL 要进入系统、准备被处理时触发；在文档流水线中作为第一道闸门先执行扫描。

say.text: 请扫描这个 PDF 文件，给出 pass/reject 判定和报告。
say.note: 对本地文件执行安检并返回扫描报告。

say.text: 检查这个网址是否命中黑名单，我先看看再决定用不用。
say.note: 对 URL 解析域名后对照黑名单检查。

say.text: 用自定义合规策略扫描这份 Word 文档并给出判定。
say.note: 覆盖默认策略，按自定义规则集执行扫描。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude acts as the document-entry security gatekeeper: when a file or URL arrives, it runs a security and compliance scan first—checking domain blacklists, license status, and suspicious sources—then returns a pass/reject verdict and scan report with a trace ID.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a file or URL is submitted into the system; it must run before any document processing as the first gate in the pipeline.

say_en.text: Please scan this PDF file and return a pass/reject verdict and report.
say_en.note: Runs the scan locally and returns a report.

say_en.text: Check whether this URL hits the blacklist before I use it.
say_en.note: Resolves the domain and checks it against blacklists.

say_en.text: Scan this Word document using a custom compliance policy.
say_en.note: Uses a custom ruleset instead of the default policy.
